output_digests.note: For this release the payloads are the release assets and the contract manifest restates their digests; the envelope restates both so a consumer verifies without trusting the manifest beyond its own pin digest. rows = record count (verb roots / nominal lemmas / passages) as recorded in the contract manifest.

config.selection_rule: the three v1 contract payloads listed in the contract manifest's files[] plus the four JSON Schemas in schemas[]
config.digest_form: sha256 over the LF-canonical form (CRLF normalised); every pinned blob is LF-only, so lf-canonical equals raw blob bytes — verified byte-identical at authoring

upstream_corpus.note: DCS-2026 upstream release pinned in CITATION.cff; the SQLite master is an upstream release asset, not a tracked file in this repo, so no file-level digest is recomputable at this tag — recorded, never fabricated. A post-release master digest is recorded on main as src/DCS-data-2026/dcs_full.sqlite.sha256 (8f3b06bd6ef0e47a9ccf81d147e73d5d240d64e0c12f6d789262eb422ebb23bc).

config.concordance_linking: citation prefix-match strategy (strip trailing ': N'): 26,701 citations scanned, 60 resolved, 26,641 unresolved retained verbatim — never fuzzy-linked; 22/40 passages link-reachable, 18 named zero-link gaps carried with linkedFormCount 0
